integrity.method: Two exact standalone enumerations from LCF edges and separate nine-block incidence coordinates; all states/adjacencies and all-source distances match one finite certificate.

scientific_limitations: The theorem is an exhaustive exact classification for one fixed eighteen-vertex Pappus graph, not an all-graph connectivity theorem. Historical priority may be limited by unindexed computations; 2012 and 2021 class-counting literature is explicitly credited, and the class count alone is not asserted to be new.
title: Two tetrahedral windmills in Pappus edge-Kempe reconfiguration
